summary.name: Mathias Lafeldt
summary.one_liner: Personal homepage of Mathias Lafeldt, an indie product engineer from Germany who builds tools for developers and offers freelance work.

find a contractor for serverless or cloud work
summary.what_it_does: The page is a personal homepage for Mathias Lafeldt, an indie product engineer from Germany. It describes his background: programming since the early 2000s, roughly a decade running production systems on AWS, and a focus on building products for developers. He lists technologies he is currently interested in, including Rust, Zig, TypeScript, Cloudflare, Astro, and DuckDB. He says he uses AI across the product lifecycle. He also states he is available for freelance engagements, from one-time support to long-term product development. No specific product features, prices, or downloadable tools are described on this page.
notable: Former AWS production operator turned indie product engineer
Has worked on a website builder, a chaos engineering platform, and a GraphQL-at-the-edge provider
caveats: Page is a personal homepage with no details on specific tools or pricing
Freelance availability is for client engagements, not a self-serve product
